name: neveroff-console
description: Admin & Trust/Safety console for the NeverOff messenger platform

scripts.// build:shared: Everything imports @neveroff-console/shared, whose package.json points at dist/. Nothing that consumes it works until this has run at least once, so every entry point below depends on it.
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run migrate --workspace @neveroff-console/db
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed --workspace @neveroff-console/api
scripts.setup:local: npm run build:shared && npm run stack:up && npm run db:bootstrap && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
